paragraphs.text: The Nameless Angel was an angel from Innistrad , that was worshiped in the Approaches of Kessig .

A beautiful, yet otherworldly figure of pale, selenic skin and gossamer hair, clad in a red and white robe. Although she represented the Church of Avacyn , many of the local priests would rather wear her symbol (spreading wings) than that of Avacyn . The Archangel was considered too far-off a divinity, and the faithful Approachers preferred a more personal angel.

The Nameless Angel had granted the Approaches the boon of the Seelenstone , the relic of the priory. Villagers were proud of the relic, which stilled the souls of the church's followers, preventing them from rising as a geist or other foul creature. But it also prevented a soul from returning to the Bog . And so while the Approachers were proud of the Nameless Angel's blessing, most still resisted conversion to the Church of Avacyn.

After the Angel became struck by Emrakul 's madness, she was locked away by the people of the Priory. She was killed by the old hunter Rom and nailed to a wall in the catacombs. Her body didn't decompose, and her blood stayed wet. Her soul spoke to Tacenda Verlasen and helped her defeat her sister Willia.
